documentationContract.rationale: The pinned public API describes a synchronous bounded ASTC memory probe with three caller-owned scalar outputs. The 16-byte preflight is a stable ASTC container-format recipe. Selection uses ABI shape plus structured documentation facts, never a header, symbol, prefix, or route allowlist.
